newsitem.title: USA: Sharon Energy grants stock options.
newsitem.headline: Sharon Energy grants stock options.

text.p: Sharon Energy Ltd said Tuesday options to purchase up to 275,000 of its common shares have been granted as of April 15 pursuant to the Stock Option Plan approved by directors on March 28.
It said the options remain to Vancouver Stock Exchange and shareholder approval.
Sharon said the options will be priced at C$1.32 which is the ten-day average of the closing prices of its shares on the Vancouver Stock Exchange prior to the date of the grant.
The aggregate number of options granted to directors and officers of Sharon is 725,000, it said.
The aggregate number of options granted to employees who are neither officers nor directors is 128,000. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
